propositions: Whole-tree fixture helpers exported all 3,019 checkout files instead of just hatch_build.py, pyproject.toml, and src/rebar/__init__.py, causing unnecessary build overhead across xdist workers.
The artifact-probe workflow used GITHUB_SHA instead of deriving the final checked-out HEAD SHA, causing wrong but nonempty provenances to pass on patchset builds.
Xdist session fixture initialized independently on all three workers, each paying 6.60-6.74s setup cost despite identical build semantics.
Production hatch_build.py on a minimal committed package reduced paired build totals from 6.30/9.26s to 2.66/5.43s while preserving exact fallback SHA and all contract behaviors.
Both artifact-probe workflow lanes must derive exact git rev-parse output after final checkout and assert exact equality rather than truthiness for installed wheel and sdist.
